summary: A Yes vote continues the town's paramedic services special tax for four years at up to $94.50 per residential unit or per 1,000 square feet of nonresidential space, adjustable to a maximum of $117.75.

tax.text: A Yes vote approves extending and increasing property taxes to fund paramedic services.
tax.quote: Measure Q seeks to catch Corte Madera up on its contributions to the Ross Valley Paramedic Authority by imposing a tax of up to $94.50 per dwelling or 1,000 square feet of developed nonresidential property.

tax.text: A No vote rejects the proposed property tax extension and increase.
